text_en: The Israelites again did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , after Ehud died.
text_cn: 厄胡得死后，以色列子民又行了上主视为恶的事。

text_en: So the Lord sold them into the hand of King Jabin of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the commander of his army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth-ha-goiim.
text_cn: 因此上主将他们交在客纳罕王雅宾手中，他当时在哈祚尔为王，他的军长息色辣驻扎在哈洛舍特哥因。

text_en: Then the Israelites cried out to the Lord for help; for he had nine hundred chariots of iron, and had oppressed the Israelites cruelly twenty years.
text_cn: 因为雅宾王有九百辆铁甲车，极力压迫以色列子民已有二十年之久，以色列子民遂呼吁上主。

text_en: At that time Deborah, a prophetess, wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel.
text_cn: 当时有一位女先知德波辣是拉丕多特的妻子，作以色列的民长。

text_en: She used to sit under the palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the Israelites came up to her for judgment.
text_cn: 她常坐在厄弗辣因山地、辣玛和贝特耳中间的那棵德波辣棕树下，以色列子民都到她那里去听判断。

text_en: She sent and summoned Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali, and said to him, “The Lord , the God of Israel, commands you, ‘Go, take position at Mount Tabor, bringing ten thousand from the tribe of Naphtali and the tribe of Zebulun.
text_cn: 她打发人从纳斐塔里刻德士把阿彼诺罕的儿子巴辣克叫来，对他说：“这是上主以色列的天主的命令：你要从纳斐塔里和则步隆子孙中，率领一万人向大博尔山进发：

text_en: I will draw out Sisera, the general of Jabin’s army, to meet you by the Wadi Kishon with his chariots and his troops; and I will give him into your hand. ’”
text_cn: 我要引领雅宾的将军息色辣和他的车辆军队到克雄河畔，到你跟前来，把他交在你手中。”

text_en: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go. ”
text_cn: 巴辣克对她说：“你若同我去，我就去；你若不同我去，我就不去。”

text_en: And she said, “I will surely go with you; nevertheless, the road on which you are going will not lead to your glory, for the Lord will sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. ” Then Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh.
text_cn: 她回答说：“我一定同你去，但是你此行并无光荣，因为上主要把息色辣交在一个女子手中。” 于是德波辣起身同巴辣克往刻德士去了。

text_en: Barak summoned Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and ten thousand warriors went up behind him; and Deborah went up with him.
text_cn: 巴辣克召集则步隆和纳斐塔里的子孙到刻德士去，跟他上去的有一万人，德波辣也同他上去了。

text_en: Now Heber the Kenite had separated from the other Kenites, that is, the descendants of Hobab the father-in-law of Moses, and had encamped as far away as Elon-bezaanannim, which is near Kedesh.
text_cn: 那时刻尼人赫贝尔离开别的刻尼人，离开梅瑟的姻亲曷巴布的子孙，在刻德士附近的匝阿纳宁橡树旁支搭了帐幕。

text_en: When Sisera was told that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor,
text_cn: 有人报告息色辣：阿彼诺罕的儿子巴辣克已上了大博尔山。

text_en: Sisera called out all his chariots, nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the troops who were with him, from Harosheth-ha-goiim to the Wadi Kishon.
text_cn: 息色辣遂召集他所有的车辆，即那九百辆铁甲车，和随从他的全军，从哈洛舍特哥因出来。到了克雄河畔。

text_en: Then Deborah said to Barak, “Up! For this is the day on which the Lord has given Sisera into your hand. The Lord is indeed going out before you. ” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor with ten thousand warriors following him.
text_cn: 德波辣对巴辣克说：“起来！因为今天上主已把息色辣交在你手中。上主不是走在你前面吗？”于是巴辣克从大博尔山下来，那一万人跟在他后面。

text_en: And the Lord threw Sisera and all his chariots and all his army into a panic before Barak; Sisera got down from his chariot and fled away on foot,
text_cn: 当时上主用利剑在巴辣克前面扰乱了息色辣和他的车辆以及他的军队，息色辣下车，徒步逃跑了。

text_en: while Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth-ha-goiim. All the army of Sisera fell by the sword; no one was left.
text_cn: 巴辣克就追赶车辆和军队，直追到哈洛舍特哥因；息色辣的全军都丧身刀下，一个也没有剩下。

text_en: Now Sisera had fled away on foot to the tent of Jael wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between King Jabin of Hazor and the clan of Heber the Kenite.
text_cn: 息色辣徒步逃到刻尼人赫贝尔的妻子雅厄耳的帐幕那里，因为哈祚尔王雅宾和刻尼人赫贝尔的家族相安无事。

text_en: Jael came out to meet Sisera, and said to him, “Turn aside, my lord, turn aside to me; have no fear. ” So he turned aside to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.
text_cn: 雅厄耳出来迎接息色辣，向他说：“我主！请你躲起来，躲在我这里，不必害怕！”他就躲在她的帐幕里；雅厄耳就用毯子盖住他。

text_en: Then he said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. ” So she opened a skin of milk and gave him a drink and covered him.
text_cn: 息色辣对她说：“请给我一点水喝！因为我渴了。”她就打开皮囊给他奶喝，然后又盖住他。

text_en: He said to her, “Stand at the entrance of the tent, and if anybody comes and asks you, ‘Is anyone here? ’ say, ‘No. ’”
text_cn: 息色辣又向她说：“你站在帐幕门口，若有人来问你说：这里有人吗？你就回答说：没有。”

text_en: But Jael wife of Heber took a tent peg, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him and drove the peg into his temple, until it went down into the ground—he was lying fast asleep from weariness—and he died.
text_cn: 那时，赫贝尔的妻子雅厄耳取了一根帐棚上的木橛，手里拿着锤子，悄悄走到息色辣前，把木橛钉在他的太阳穴里，一直钉到地上；那时他正疲乏熟睡，就这样死去。

text_en: Then, as Barak came in pursuit of Sisera, Jael went out to meet him, and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man whom you are seeking. ” So he went into her tent; and there was Sisera lying dead, with the tent peg in his temple.
text_cn: 那时巴辣克正在追赶息色辣，雅厄耳出来迎接他，对他说：“来！我给你看看你所追寻的人。”他来到她那里，看，息色辣已躺在那里死了！木橛在他的太阳穴中。

text_en: So on that day God subdued King Jabin of Canaan before the Israelites.
text_cn: 这样，那一天天主在以色列子民面前制伏了客纳罕王雅宾。

text_en: Then the hand of the Israelites bore harder and harder on King Jabin of Canaan, until they destroyed King Jabin of Canaan.
text_cn: 以色列子民的力量日渐强大，超过了客纳罕王雅宾，直到将他消灭。
